name: 11229 · Brooklyn, NY
findings: ZIP 11229 (Brooklyn) has 441 nonprofit organizations. 172 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 164 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (71% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11229 (Brooklyn) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
